prompt: Show the 12 months of 2023 with total revenue and total units sold. Show then a line chart showing monthly revenue trends for 2023

answers.message: My proposed plan is - Retriever, Analyzer, Visualizer
The data has been retrieved (12 entries with columns : month, total_revenue, total_units_sold)

agent_output.sql_query:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', s.Sold_Date) AS month,
  SUM(s.Total_Sale_Value) AS total_revenue,
  SUM(s.Qty_Sold) AS total_units_sold
FROM sales s
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.Sold_Date) = 2023
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

Based on the data, the 12 months of 2023 show monthly revenue and units sold as follows: Jan ($434,172.81, 33,653), Feb ($411,762.72, 31,545), Mar ($423,070.84, 32,460), Apr ($384,479.68, 30,199), May ($381,326.43, 31,154), Jun ($364,806.74, 29,082), Jul ($353,284.21, 27,932), Aug ($401,061.54, 31,903), Sep ($422,554.97, 31,847), Oct ($454,231.06, 38,208), Nov ($511,104.29, 41,043), and Dec ($874,263.67, 60,941). Revenue and units sold trended downward from January to July (reaching a low of $353,284.21 and 27,932 units in July), then consistently increased to a peak in December at $874,263.67 and 60,941 units, totaling $5,416,118.93 in revenue and 419,967 units for the year. I cannot provide a visual line chart, but the monthly trend clearly shows a mid-year slump followed by a strong Q4 recovery, with December outperforming all other months by a wide margin.
